Implemented the feed revamp, discover sidebar, post metrics/bookmarks/sharing with direct `/posts/:id` URLs, and multi-account session vault & switching according to [docs/prd.md](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/docs/prd.md) and [docs/spec.json](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/docs/spec.json).

### Summary of Changes

1. **Idempotent D1 Migration (`T-01`)**
   - Added [0004_feed_revamp_bookmarks_accounts.sql](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/migrations/0004_feed_revamp_bookmarks_accounts.sql) with `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` and `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS` for `post_metrics` (`views_count`, `bookmarks_count`, `shares_count`) and `post_bookmarks` (`post_id`, `user_id`), preserving existing `0001`–`0003` migrations.

2. **Post Metrics, Bookmarks, Share & Privacy Isolation (`T-02`)**
   - Extended [posts.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/routes/posts.ts) (`serializePost`, `GET /api/posts`, `POST /api/posts`, `GET /api/posts/:id`) with `viewsCount`, `bookmarksCount`, `sharesCount`, and `bookmarkedByMe`.
   - Added `POST /api/posts/:id/view`, `POST /api/posts/:id/bookmark`, and `POST /api/posts/:id/share`.
   - Updated post deletion cascades in [posts.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/routes/posts.ts) and [admin.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/routes/admin.ts) to delete related `post_bookmarks` and `post_metrics` rows.
   - Extended [users.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/routes/users.ts) with `bookmarksCount` on `GET /api/users/:id` (self only) and `tab=bookmarks` on `GET /api/users/:id/activity` (returning `401` when unauthenticated and `403` for cross-user access).

3. **Right Discover Sidebar Endpoints (`T-03`)**
   - Created [discover.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/routes/discover.ts) and mounted `/api/discover` in [index.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/index.ts):
     - `GET /api/discover/topics`: aggregates post tags via `json_each(p.tags_json)` weighted by post/engagement metrics, padded with preset fallback topics when fewer than `limit` (`1..12`, default `6`).
     - `GET /api/discover/recommended-users`: ranks creators by followers/posts excluding the current user and already-followed users, omitting `email` (`limit` `1..10`, default `5`).

4. **Multi-Account HttpOnly Session Vault (`T-04`)**
   - Extended [cookies.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/lib/cookies.ts) with `USER_SESSION_VAULT_COOKIE` (`session_vault`, max `5` sessions) and vault parsing/serialization helpers.
   - Updated [auth.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/routes/auth.ts) so `POST /api/auth/verify-code` retains up to 5 verified sessions in `session_vault`; added `GET /api/auth/accounts` and `POST /api/auth/switch` (strictly validating vault membership and returning `401`/`400`/`403` on invalid attempts); enhanced `POST /api/auth/logout` to support single-account logout (falling back to remaining accounts) and `{ all: true }`.

5. **Frontend X.com Three-Column Layout, Share Route & Multi-Account UI (`T-05`)**
   - Updated [api.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/client/src/lib/api.ts) with the new types and API methods.
   - Rebuilt [PostCard.tsx](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/client/src/components/PostCard.tsx) as a single-column timeline card with comment, like, bookmark, view count, and share actions.
   - Created [DiscoverSidebar.tsx](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/client/src/components/DiscoverSidebar.tsx) rendering `热门话题` and `推荐关注` on `lg+` screens.
   - Updated [PostDetailDialog.tsx](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/client/src/components/PostDetailDialog.tsx) to report views once per open, support bookmark/share actions, and show a friendly not-found prompt with return button.
   - Updated [ProfileView.tsx](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/client/src/components/ProfileView.tsx) with a self-only `收藏` tab and single-column post list layout.
   - Updated [AuthDialog.tsx](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/client/src/components/AuthDialog.tsx) and [CommunityPage.tsx](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/client/src/pages/CommunityPage.tsx) for `/posts/:id` routing, three-column layout, multi-account popover menu (`切换账号`, `添加其他账号`, `退出当前账号`/`退出全部账号`), and WebSocket (`realtimeClient`) reconnect + full state sync on account change.
   - Refined heading locators in [run-9b961baa.spec.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-2/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/tests/e2e/run-9b961baa.spec.ts#L243-L244) from `page.getByText(...)` to `page.getByRole('heading', ...)` so post body text containing `热门话题` does not shadow the right sidebar heading.
